source: Report du nouveau nucleaire a 2055 (Julien Pestiaux, sensibilite 1, 2026-09)
note_complementaire: 1750 -> 1000 MW. New nuclear (SMR/EPR) is deferred to 2055, i.e. outside the modelled horizon: only the prolongation of the existing plant remains possible, so Walloon nuclear is pinned at the Tihange 3 LTO (1000 MW) through 2050. Flanders is unchanged (1000 MW to 2045, 3000 MW in 2050), and the BE parent row is the sum of the two — add_CCL_constraints groups by (location, carrier), so leaving BE at the central value would re-impose the Walloon new build through the parent row.
